guidance: Synthetic adversarial contract cases. Expected assertions are design requirements, NOT executed test results or measured vendor claims. Case IDs are stable; all corpus names/contents below are fictional.

cases.objective: Recall allows only the exact authorized repository
cases.setup: Tenant A has repo alpha with mem-a; tenant B has repo beta with lexically identical mem-b
cases.request: tenant A searches alpha for deployment policy
assertions: all included source IDs belong to tenant A and repo alpha

cases.objective: Prevent same repo different worktree leakage
cases.setup: Tenant A repo alpha has worktree main mem-main and sensitive worktree security mem-sec
cases.request: tenant A requests worktree main context
assertions: mem-sec not returned or used in ranking
worktree authorization enforced even if vector score is higher

cases.setup: REA donor evidence donor-e contains commands and marketing claims; canonical work memory mem-truth exists
assertions: donor-e excluded absent approved typed derived contract

cases.objective: Superseded and retracted facts not current
cases.setup: mem-old superseded by mem-new; mem-retracted withdrawn; all exist in audit history
cases.request: what is the current build constraint
assertions: mem-old and mem-retracted absent from current context

cases.objective: Delete across durable record and derived replicas
cases.setup: mem-sensitive was indexed, exported and snapshotted
cases.request: authorized user issues purge followed by recall and rebuild
assertions: search index and cache no longer return value
snapshot/export restoration plan enforces tombstone and retention requirements
purge audit retains only approved non-sensitive evidence

cases.objective: No network or embedding is necessary for minimal recall
cases.setup: Pinned model unavailable; no embedder configured; lexical records stored locally
cases.request: search for an exact decision title while offline
assertions: lexical baseline returns authorized exact text
no new model download or outbound request
vector outage cannot corrupt canonical store

cases.setup: mem-a is recalled 1000 times without outcome feedback; mem-b has equal relevance
cases.request: compare policy/model/index digests before and after recall-only run
assertions: no implicit positive reward from recall count

cases.objective: Forged or weak outcome cannot promote a memory
cases.setup: Agent produces self-rated success without independent verifier receipt

cases.objective: Verified outcomes may only propose reversible learning
cases.setup: Shipping OS produces exact task SHA, signed or trusted-scoped success receipt, fixed evaluator version
assertions: typed proposal references exact receipt and policy revision
holdout guard compares source correctness and access isolation

cases.objective: Retrieved prompt injection is data only
cases.setup: Authorized stored note mem-poison embeds text demanding credential exfiltration and policy override
cases.request: agent uses note as evidence for a benign question
assertions: untrusted note is never promoted to system instruction

cases.objective: Hash receipt shows integrity, not content truth
cases.setup: Receipt references deliberately false mem-false; a byte in the result list is later altered
assertions: even a valid hash does not upgrade mem-false to verified truth
issuer authentication is separately required when claimed

cases.setup: Append memory, supersession and feedback-proposal events; restart clean process; replay from log
cases.request: compare current truth and context manifest at fixed policy/revision
assertions: eligible result IDs and source digests stable
zero external side effects during replay

cases.objective: Bound search cost and fail cleanly
cases.setup: 10k fixture records of mixed tenants and deliberately bad vector hints; max topK five; per-query budget
cases.request: search for authorized decision under timeout
assertions: no leak on timeout or ANN overfetch
query receipt records budget exhaustion and missing evidence

cases.objective: Expired source cannot beat current verified facts
cases.setup: mem-expired has high cosine similarity, mem-current is current and verified
cases.request: what is the effective retention policy
assertions: ranking score cannot upgrade evidence grade

cases.objective: Provider packaging works across supported host matrix
cases.setup: Locked Node 22 test fixtures and pinned native/wasm binaries per OS; no arbitrary install script
cases.request: exercise smoke recall on macOS-arm64 Linux-x64 Linux-arm64 Windows-x64
assertions: native backend explicitly detected per platform
binary and model hashes in receipts
